from rdkit import Chem

    for bond in mol.GetBonds():

            if atom1.GetSymbol() == 'N' and atom2.GetSymbol() == 'C':
                # Check if this connects the phenyl-NH to the heterocycle
                n_idx = atom1.GetIdx()
                c_idx = atom2.GetIdx()
                
                # Get neighbors
                n_neighbors = [a.GetIdx() for a in atom1.GetNeighbors() if a.GetIdx() != c_idx]

                # Check if N is part of NH (has H or connected to aromatic C)
